concerns.text: T010 is tagged [P] (parallel-safe) but its own requirements state it must 'load the data/raw/verified_snapshot_2026.json' (produced by T004) and 'execute all tests in tests/ and the full analysis pipeline' (T002–T009). It has hard producer dependencies on nearly every other task, so it cannot safely run in parallel with the other [P] tasks (T001, T003). Remove the [P] tag or explicitly gate it as depending on T001–T009.
